zh-CN.name: VPT
zh-CN.description: 在 Taro 项目里用 Vite 做开发与构建，而不是老的 webpack 链路。它负责把现有 React 工程接入工具链。
zh-CN.audience: 希望复用 React 与 Taro 组件和 API，并使用现代 Vite 工具链开发微信、支付宝小程序与 Web 应用的前端团队。
useCases: 使用 npm create vite-taro@latest my-app 创建跨端 React 项目
在微信开发者工具中编辑 React 组件并保留页面、组件和输入状态
通过标准静态与动态导入自动规划微信小程序分包
capabilities: 微信小程序全自动分包
Tailwind CSS v4 开箱即用
微信 Skyline 渲染模式

faqs.question: VPT 与 Taro 是什么关系？
faqs.answer: VPT 是 vite-plugin-taro 的简称，使用 Taro 组件、API 和运行时，通过 Vite 驱动开发与构建，而不是沿用旧式 webpack 链路。

faqs.question: VPT 支持哪些平台？
faqs.answer: 当前支持微信小程序、支付宝小程序与 Web（H5），分别使用 wx、zfb 和 h5 构建目标。

faqs.question: 如何开始使用 VPT？
faqs.answer: 新项目推荐运行 npm create vite-taro@latest my-app。已有 Taro 项目请阅读官方迁移指南；安装插件后仍需按文档配置 Vite 和项目入口。

en.name: VPT
en.description: Use Vite for Taro development and builds instead of the older webpack pipeline. It connects existing React projects to the toolchain.
en.audience: Frontend teams that want to reuse React and Taro components and APIs while developing WeChat, Alipay, and Web apps with a modern Vite toolchain.
useCases: Create a cross-platform React project with npm create vite-taro@latest my-app
Edit React components in WeChat DevTools while preserving page, component, and input state
Plan WeChat mini-program subpackages automatically from standard static and dynamic imports
capabilities: Tailwind CSS v4 out of the box

faqs.question: How does VPT relate to Taro?
faqs.answer: VPT is short for vite-plugin-taro. It uses Taro components, APIs, and runtime with Vite-powered development and builds instead of the older webpack pipeline.

faqs.question: Which platforms does VPT support?
faqs.answer: VPT currently supports WeChat mini-programs, Alipay mini-programs, and the Web (H5), using the wx, zfb, and h5 build targets respectively.

faqs.question: How do I get started with VPT?
faqs.answer: For a new project, run npm create vite-taro@latest my-app. For an existing Taro project, follow the official migration guide; installing the plugin still requires configuring Vite and project entries as documented.
